scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:product && npm run deploy:studio
scripts.deploy:product: npm run build -w apps/product && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy apps/product/dist --project-name room3d-product --branch main
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run build -w apps/studio-jeop && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy apps/studio-jeop/dist --project-name studio-jeop --branch main
